reason: National program. The list is now New York City only.

record.name: Answer a letter to Santa
record.summary: Choose a letter to Santa from a child or family and send a gift they asked for.
record.about: USPS Operation Santa is a US Postal Service program, started in 1912. It lets people adopt letters sent to Santa and send the gifts. It is not a charity.
record.cost: You choose. You also pay for shipping.

stepGroups.title: Mail a gift yourself
steps: Create a free account and verify your identity.
Read the letters and adopt one or more.

steps.text: Send the gifts by December 12 one of these ways:
choices: Buy them yourself and ship them from a participating Post Office.
Order them from Santa's Gift Shoppe, and USPS delivers them.

record.note: The site closes at 8 pm Eastern on December 12. It is open to people in the continental US, Hawaii, and Puerto Rico. Letters go quickly and the ID check takes time, so start early.

options.text: Buy the gifts and ship them from a Post Office.
After you adopt a letter, you can order from Santa's Gift Shoppe and USPS delivers.

signup.text: Create a free account and verify your ID.

rows.name: Adopt a letter, then send the gifts
rows.text: Adopt a letter and ship the gifts by December 12. The site closes at 8 pm Eastern that day. Ship from a Post Office, or order from Santa's Gift Shoppe and USPS delivers them.

reason: National program. The list is now New York City only.

record.name: Answer Christmas letters from trans youth
record.summary: Read Christmas letters from trans youth and send a gift they picked out, without exchanging personal information.
record.about: Transanta is a trans-led gift-giving project for trans young people that started in 2020. It's part of Allies in Arts, a nonprofit.

stepGroups.title: Buy from their wish list
steps: Open the Transanta homepage and scroll down. The letters are below the newsletter sign-up.
Pick a letter and open that young person's gift registry.
Choose a gift and check out. It ships to them, and their address stays private.

options.text: Scroll down their homepage to find the letters. Your gift ships to the young person whose letter you pick.

record.note: The campaign runs each year from about mid-November to mid-January.

reason: No New York City office in the 2026 list of participating offices.

record.name: Be a Santa to a Senior
record.summary: Pick a gift an older adult in your area asked for, like a warm blanket.
record.about: Home Instead is a company that provides in-home care for older adults, founded in 1994 in Omaha, Nebraska. Its local offices collect and deliver the gifts.
record.cost: You choose. Requests are often basics like blankets.

stepGroups.title: Drop off a gift
steps: Find your local office in the list. Every office on the list takes part this year.
Check the office's website or Facebook page, or call, to learn where its gift trees are. They are often in stores, banks, and libraries.
Pick an ornament from a tree. Each one lists a gift an older adult asked for.
Buy the gift and return it the way your office asks.

stepGroups.title: Buy from their wish list
steps: Find your local office in the list. A few offices show an Amazon link.
Open that office's wish list.
Choose a gift and check out.

record.note: Dates are different at each office. No New York City or Long Island office is on the 2026 list.

options.text: Pick a gift request from one of your office's gift trees, buy the gift, and bring it back to the same place.
A few offices also have an Amazon wish list. The office list shows an Amazon link beside those.

reason: Points to the nationwide Walmart locator.

record.name: Buy a gift for a local child (Angel Tree)
record.summary: Pick a child's Angel Tree tag or shop your local Walmart registry to give toys or clothes to kids in your community.
record.about: The Salvation Army is a Christian church that also runs social services, active in the US since 1880. It started Angel Tree in 1979 to give Christmas gifts to children in need.
record.cost: You choose from the wish list.

stepGroups.title: Buy from their wish list
steps: Enter your ZIP code to find your local Salvation Army.
Add gifts from its wish list to your Walmart cart.
Check out with delivery. Walmart ships the gifts to the Salvation Army for you.

stepGroups.title: Drop off a gift
steps: Find an Angel Tree in a participating Walmart or Sam's Club.
Take a paper tag from the tree. Each tag lists what one child wished for.
Buy the gifts.
Leave them unwrapped in the store's collection bin.

record.note: Dates are different in each area. Check with your local Salvation Army.

options.text: Shop the Walmart registry. It ships to your local Salvation Army.
Pick a child's tag from an Angel Tree in a participating Walmart or Sam's Club, and leave the gifts in the store.

signup.text: None. You enter your ZIP code.

record.name: Fill a virtual toy box
record.org: Marine Toys for Tots with Amazon
record.summary: Pick a toy online, and Toys for Tots will distribute it to a child who could use a Christmas gift.
record.about: Toys for Tots began in 1947 with a Marine Corps Reserve unit and now collects gifts for children across the US. The Marine Toys for Tots Foundation partners with Amazon on this virtual toy box.
record.cost: About $3 to $180 per toy. Many options are under $30.

stepGroups.title: Buy from their wish list
steps: Open the toy catalog.
Add one or more toys to your toy box. It works like a shopping cart.
Check out. Toys for Tots delivers the toys to children across the country.

action.label: Shop the virtual toy box
action.srExtra: Marine Toys for Tots with Amazon

record.note: No deadline is listed. The page also has a link for giving cash.

reason: Points to the national wish catalog.

record.name: Grant a wish for an older adult
record.summary: Chip in toward an older adult's wish, from hearing aids to a trip somewhere they've always wanted to visit.
record.about: Twilight Wish Foundation is a nonprofit founded in 2003 in Bucks County, Pennsylvania. It grants wishes for adults 65 and older who have limited incomes or live in long-term care facilities.

stepGroups.title: Give money
steps: Read the open wishes.
Open a wish and use its donation link.
Enter the amount you want to give.

record.note: Twilight Wish tries to use your gift for the wish you chose. If it can't, the money goes to a similar urgent wish. Questions: 877-893-9474 (toll-free).

reason: Regional program, not limited to New York City. Gifts ship to Star Lake Camp in New Jersey.

record.name: Adopt an Angel in Greater New York
record.org: The Salvation Army Greater New York
record.summary: Choose a child's Angel Tag and buy a gift they asked for on their Christmas wish list.
record.about: The Salvation Army is a Christian church that also runs social services, active in the US since 1880. It started Angel Tree in 1979 to give Christmas gifts to children in need. Its Greater New York branch runs this one.
record.cost: $25 minimum per child. $25 to $50 is suggested.

stepGroups.title: Mail or drop off a gift
steps: Adopt an Angel by choosing one child on the online Angel Tree.
Buy at least one unwrapped toy from the child's list, worth $25 or more.
Write the child's Angel ID on the gift note or on the second address line.
Ship or deliver it to Star Lake Camp Toy Shop, 268 Macopin Rd, Bloomingdale, NJ 07403.

action.label: Adopt an Angel
action.srExtra: The Salvation Army Greater New York

record.note: Aim for your gift to arrive by December 11. December 14 is the final day. The guide also lists toy pickup by appointment through December 11.

signup.text: Adopt an Angel online to get the child's wish list.

rows.name: Adopt an Angel, then send the toys
rows.text: Buy the toys, then ship or deliver them with the child's Angel ID.

record.name: Bring Joy Home toy drive
record.summary: Choose a shelter, supportive housing site, or afterschool program and send a gift from its wish list.
record.about: CAMBA is a Brooklyn nonprofit, founded in 1977. It runs shelters, family support, and youth programs across New York City.
record.cost: You choose from the wish list.

stepGroups.title: Buy from their wish list
steps: On the CAMBA page, pick a site's Amazon wish list.
Choose a gift.
Check out. It ships to that site for you.
Fill out CAMBA's short donor form so staff know the gift is coming and can send you a tax receipt.

stepGroups.title: Give money
steps: Open the CAMBA page.
Use the "Make a Cash Donation" link.

record.note: Two more CAMBA sites say their wish list is coming soon. Questions: development@CAMBA.org.

signup.text: None. After you order, fill out a short form.

options.text: Each CAMBA site has its own wish list. Pick a site, and your gift ships straight there.
The CAMBA page has a "Make a Cash Donation" link.

link.label: Give money on the CAMBA page

record.name: Grant a wish for a child in foster care
record.summary: Fund a wish, like art supplies or a bike, for a child or young adult affected by foster care or a crisis.
record.about: One Simple Wish is a nonprofit, founded in 2008. It grants wishes for children and young adults affected by foster care and crisis, working with agencies across the US.
record.cost: Full wishes range from under $25 to over $200. Some accept partial donations.

stepGroups.title: Give money
steps: Browse the wishes. Choose “Holiday Wishes” to see the seasonal list.
Pay for a wish, or pay part of a wish that allows it.
One Simple Wish buys the gift and gets it to the child.
